description: This file defines a readonly struct PsMsg used for representing message identifiers and messages within the PDFsharp library, including properties for event identification.

classes.name: PsMsg
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a message with an ID, message text, event ID, and event name.

methods.name: EventId
methods.description: Returns an EventId constructed from the message ID and the event name.

methods.name: EventName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the message ID.
